## About
Park Place Porsche Dallas is the service center for Porsche owners on Lemmon Avenue. Our technicians are Porsche-certified and trained at dedicated Porsche technical centers, so they know these cars inside and out.
We work with a complete line of factory-certified diagnostic equipment and use only genuine Porsche parts. If you have a question about anything, please ask. Someone on our staff will be glad to help.
While your car is with us, you can wait in our client lounge with Wi-Fi and a computer work station, or take our complimentary shuttle to and from the dealership. Google reviewers rate us 4.5 from 555 reviews.

## Services
- Maintenance and repair: Routine maintenance like an oil change or tire rotation, plus mechanical repairs for your Porsche.
- Genuine Porsche parts: Replacement parts straight from Porsche, chosen for quality and reliability.
- Interior and exterior detailing: Complete interior and exterior details for your Porsche.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes. We keep Saturday hours, along with extended weekday hours, so it's easier to fit service into your week.

Q: Can I get a loaner car while my Porsche is in for service?
A: A complimentary loaner vehicle is available with eligible service work. Mention it when you schedule and we can let you know if your visit qualifies.

Q: Does my Porsche come with roadside assistance?
A: In most cases, roadside assistance coverage extends through your warranty period.
